families.notes: helper gelu_functor (x*0.5*(1+erf(x/1.41421356237))) is also used by _fp_matmul epilogue. domain: contiguous input, flat 1D grid. deviation: 1/sqrt(2) truncated constant; x/c is promoted to fp32 (Triton div rule) but 0.5*x stays in input dtype for fp16.

families.reference: mlp_after_attn&pre_attn_norm: h+(r+fb+a+ab)/mp; mlp_after_attn&!pre_attn_norm: h+r+fb; else: h+a+(r+fb)/mp+(ab/mp if add_attn_bias else 0)  (all .double(), biases broadcast over last dim)
families.notes: domain: hidden/residual/attn_output same shape [B,S,H] and contiguous (not asserted; bias indexed as offset % H), all same dtype; computed in input dtype (no fp32 upcast). mp_size is constexpr.

families.reference: torch.softmax(x.double() + (mask.double() if mask is not None else 0), dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
families.notes: one row per program, whole row in one block (BLOCK=next_pow2(n_cols)), fp32 math. domain: contiguous input; mask viewed as [-1,n_cols] and either a single row (stride 0) or exactly one row per flattened input row; other broadcast shapes (e.g. [B,1,1,S] vs [B,H,S,S]) read out of bounds. deviation: masked kernel subtracts the max before adding the mask (same math, different overflow behaviour).

families.reference: torch.nn.functional.layer_norm((a + residual + input_bias).double(), (N,), weight.double(), bias.double(), eps).to(a.dtype)  (residual/input_bias terms only for the fused variants)
families.notes: two-pass mean/var in fp32 per row. deviation: fused variants store a+res(+b) into a scratch ln_input of the input dtype; the mean uses the unrounded fp32 sum but variance and normalisation re-read the rounded copy; ln_input is not returned. domain: contiguous tensors, last-dim normalisation, BLOCK capped at 8192 with looping.

families.family: inference_gemm (2D gemm+bias+activation; batched 4D gemm incl. packed-QKV score/context)
families.reference: 2D: act(A.double()@B.double() + bias) with act in {none, relu, leaky_relu(0.01), gelu(erf), sigmoid}; 4D: (a.double()@b.double()) * (scale if scale>0 else 1); score: q@k^T*scale with q,k = qkv[...,:D],qkv[...,D:2D] viewed [B,S,H,hd]->[B,H,S,hd]; context: (prob@v) written back as [B,S,H*hd]
families.notes: _fp_matmul: autotuned (all configs SPLIT_K=1; SPLIT_K>1 path would use atomic_add), EVEN_K heuristic, ACC fp32 (int32 for non-float inputs), bias+activation applied in fp32 before a single cast. matmul_4d_kernel: masked loads; MASK=True (causal -inf, top-left aligned) path exists but every wrapper passes MASK=False. deviation: fp32 inputs use TF32 dot; 4D kernel rounds the product to the output dtype before multiplying by scale (double rounding); MASK early-exit path stores -inf tiles without bounds mask (OOB write if ever enabled); wrapper _score_4d_matmul ignores its input_mask/triangular arg, so the non-flash triangular attention path applies no causal mask.

families.reference: q,k,v = qkv.double().view(B,S,3,H,hd).permute(2,0,3,1,4); torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(q,k,v, attn_mask=(mask.view(B,1,1,S) if add_mask else None), is_causal=causal, scale=sm_scale).transpose(1,2).reshape(B,S,H*hd).half()
families.notes: layout fixed by API: last dim = [Q|K|V], each H heads of hd contiguous; output fp16 [B,S,H*hd]; mask is an additive key-padding mask shared by all heads/queries; causal and mask never combined (add_mask = not triangular). domain: fp16 only, hd in pow2 16..128, mask indexed with mask.stride(1) as the batch stride (works for contiguous [B,1,1,S]/[B,1,S], wrong for [B,S]). deviation: QK^T accumulated in fp16 (out_dtype=tl.float16) and q pre-scaled by sm_scale*log2(e) then rounded to fp16; additive mask added in the log2 domain without the log2(e) factor (effective mask*ln2); out-of-range keys get -10000 not -inf; mask loads are unmasked past S (OOB read).

q,k,v,o [Z,H,N,D]; make_block_ptr without boundary_check (plain loads on sm86). domain: fp16, N_CTX multiple of BLOCK (128 or 64), D pow2; all four tensors must share strides and be contiguous over (Z,H) because only off_hz*stride_qh is used as base offset. deviation: q pre-scaled by sm_scale*log2e and rounded to fp16; P cast to fp16 before PV dot.

families.reference: torch.nn.functional.silu(gate.double()) * up.double(); packed: gate, up = gate_up.chunk(2, dim=-1); backward = autograd of the same
families.notes: fp32 internal math, single rounding to input dtype; int64 offsets. domain: gate/up same shape+dtype (fp16/bf16/fp32), packed last dim even; packed backward refuses create_graph.

families.reference: torch.nn.functional.rms_norm(x.double(), (N,), weight.double(), eps).to(x.dtype); grads = autograd of the same
families.notes: forward stores fp32 rstd; dweight via per-row-block fp32 partials then torch sum. deviation (intended, mirrors eager): normalised value rounded to input dtype before *weight; backward rounds grad_out*weight and the dweight product to input dtype. domain: bf16/fp16 only, N<=2048 (one block per row), eps is constexpr (recompiles per eps).

families.reference: c,s = cos.unsqueeze(1).double(), sin.unsqueeze(1).double(); x*c + torch.cat((-x[...,D//2:], x[...,:D//2]), -1)*s  (for q and k; BACKWARD=True is the transpose: g*c + rot_half^T(g*s))
families.notes: rounds each product to input dtype as eager does, launched with enable_fp_fusion=False. domain: q,k 4D [B,H,S,D] (or [B,S,H,D] via unsqueeze_dim=2), cos/sin [B or 1,S,D] same dtype bf16/fp16, D even <=512, unit-stride last dim, cos/sin constant.

families.reference: starts=[0]+offs[:-1]; torch.cat([a[s:e].double() @ (b[g].double().T if trans_b else b[g].double()) for g,(s,e) in enumerate(zip(starts, offs))]); dw: b_grad[g] = a[s:e].T @ dout[s:e]
spec_sources: torch._grouped_mm (private aten op; 2D x 3D offs convention)
families.notes: group of each M-tile found by an unrolled scan over NUM_GROUPS (constexpr); grid upper bound cdiv(M,BM)+E. domain: offs int32 cumulative row ends, non-decreasing, offs[-1]==M (rows past offs[-1] stay uninitialised), empty groups allowed, mat_b contiguous, same dtype fp16/bf16/fp32. deviation: fp32 inputs use TF32 dot (documented).

families.reference: inv = torch.empty(n, dtype=torch.int32); inv[index.long()] = torch.arange(index.numel(), dtype=torch.int32)  (== torch.argsort(index).int() for a permutation)
families.notes: domain: index must be a permutation of [0,n); out-of-range targets are skipped, uncovered entries stay uninitialised (torch.empty), duplicate targets race (nondeterministic winner).

families.reference: buf = torch.zeros(T*K, H, dtype=torch.float64); buf[token_indices_sorted] = rows.double(); (buf.view(T,K,H) * top_scores.double().view(T,K,1)).sum(1).to(rows.dtype); grads = autograd of the same
families.notes: forward sums the K slots in slot order in fp32 with enable_fp_fusion=False; backward scatters grad rows through the inverse index and reduces grad_scores in fp32. domain: token_indices_sorted is a full permutation of [0,T*K) (else inverse has garbage entries); rows fp16/bf16/fp32; score_apply must be 'post'.
domain: rows [N,H] contiguous bf16/fp16, weights [N,1] contiguous fp32. grad_weights reduced via per-hidden-block fp32 partials then a second kernel.

families.family: fp8_weight_only_gemm (DeepSpeed FP_Quantize 8-bit weights x bf16/fp16 activations)
families.reference: candidate (lib ref): fp8_gemm.py::matmul_fp8_fallback -> torch.matmul(inp, quantizer.dequantize(weight, scale=scale))
open_decisions: 8-bit code decoding: kernel uses a bit trick (E4M3-style, exponent rebias +120 for bf16 / +8 for fp16) with no zero/subnormal/NaN handling, so code 0x00 decodes to 2^-7*scale; must be reconciled with the CUDA dequantizer
scale granularity/layout: one fp32 scale per quantization_group_size consecutive elements of the row-major [K,N] weight, indexed per N-tile (assumes group_size >= BLOCK_N and tile-aligned)
quantiser rounding (q_range clipping, optional stochastic rounding) that produced the codes
output rounding: dequantised weight rounded to bf16/fp16 before tl.dot, fp32 accumulate, single cast
spec_sources: tests/unit/ops/fp_quantizer/test_fp8_gemm.py::test_fp_quant (bf16 only, mean rel. error < 0.004 vs dequantize+matmul)
OCP 8-bit FP (OFP8) spec for E4M3 if a standard decoding is intended
families.notes: no fp8 dtypes or dot_scaled: uint8 bit manipulation + bf16/fp16 tl.dot, so runs on sm86. domain: weight uint8 [K,N] contiguous, offs %M/%N wrap, K multiple of BLOCK_K (bf16 kernel's weight mask ignores the k offset; scale loads unmasked), group_size>=BLOCK_N (64, or 128 when M>=256). deviation: fp16 kernel shifts uint8 values before widening ((w&0x80)<<8, (w&0x7f)<<7); under current Triton scalar promotion the scalar does not widen uint8, so sign/exponent bits are lost; only the bf16 path is tested.

families.reference: candidate is the lib's loop: deepspeed/moe/ep_kernels.py::fill_indices_cpu (out=full(max_len,-1); for e: w=write_offsets[e]; for r: i=r*E+e; out[w:w+len_i]=arange(start_i,start_i+len_i); w+=len_i)
families.notes: all inputs explicit, output fixed by the API; integer exact. deviation: kernel does not clamp writes at max_len (CPU reference does) -> OOB write if write_offsets+counts exceed max_len; -1 fill comes from the wrapper.

families.reference: N=src.shape[0]; torch.cat([src, src.new_zeros(1, H)])[torch.where((index>=0)&(index<N), index, N).long()]
families.notes: pure copy, exact. Used as forward of permute_rows and backward of unpermute_rows (backward of permute uses torch index_select).

families.reference: torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits.double(), target, ignore_index=ignore_index, reduction='none'); grad = autograd (ignored rows -> zero grad)
families.notes: online log-sum-exp in fp32, loss fp32 per row; backward writes grad in logits dtype. domain: targets in [0,V) or == ignore_index (no bounds check; out-of-range target reads OOB where torch raises).
